draw_pile.note: Main draw pile. Server shuffles. Replenished from completed building piles.

building_1.note: Shared building pile 1. Cards played in ascending order 1-12.

building_2.note: Shared building pile 2. Cards played in ascending order 1-12.

building_3.note: Shared building pile 3. Cards played in ascending order 1-12.

building_4.note: Shared building pile 4. Cards played in ascending order 1-12.

stockpile.note: Player stockpile. Only top card is visible. 30 cards for 2-4 players, 20 for 5-6 (configurable). First to empty wins.

hand.note: Player hand. Draw up to 5 cards at start of turn.

discard_1.note: Personal discard pile 1. Top card visible and playable.

discard_2.note: Personal discard pile 2. Top card visible and playable.

discard_3.note: Personal discard pile 3. Top card visible and playable.

discard_4.note: Personal discard pile 4. Top card visible and playable.

card.note: 162 cards: 12 each of values 1-12 (144 numbered) plus 18 Skip-Bo wild cards. Wild cards can substitute for any value.

phases.name: deal
phases.note: Shuffle deck, deal 30 cards to each player's stockpile (20 for 5-6 players variant), flip top card of each stockpile face-up.

phases.name: draw
phases.note: Active player draws cards from draw pile until hand has 5 cards. If hand is empty (all cards played previous turn), draw 5.

phases.name: play
phases.ends_when: player cannot or chooses not to play
phases.note: Active player plays cards to building piles from hand, top of stockpile, or top of any personal discard pile. May play multiple cards. Skip-Bo wilds match any value.

phases.name: discard
phases.note: Active player must discard exactly one card from hand to one of their 4 personal discard piles. This ends the turn.

building_sequence.definition: Building piles accept cards in ascending order 1 through 12
constraints: card.value == building_pile.top + 1 OR building_pile is empty AND card.value == 1
skip-bo wild card matches any required value

completed_pile.definition: When a building pile reaches 12, it is cleared and reshuffled into the draw pile

play_sources.definition: Cards may be played to building piles from hand, top of stockpile, or top of any personal discard pile
constraints: source in [hand, stockpile.top, discard_1.top, discard_2.top, discard_3.top, discard_4.top]

draw_to_five.definition: At start of turn, draw cards until hand contains 5

mandatory_discard.definition: Turn must end by discarding exactly one card from hand to a personal discard pile
mandatory_discard.constraint: must discard exactly 1 card from hand to one of [discard_1, discard_2, discard_3, discard_4]

stockpile_win.definition: First player to empty their stockpile wins, even mid-turn

skip_discard_on_empty_hand.definition: If a player plays all 5 hand cards during the play phase, skip discard and draw 5 new cards to continue playing
skip_discard_on_empty_hand.effect: draw(draw_pile, hand, count:5) and continue play phase

end_conditions.condition: draw_pile.count == 0 and no building pile can accept a play from any player
end_conditions.name: deadlock
